#Module net

Fetch with a callback (Fetch Standard through the browser's loader: origin, CORS, cookies, referrer, CSP and mixed content are the browser's business, never the module's). The callback learns each step; the response is read from the request record until Fetch_release. A Response (module fetch) is the same record.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/net.widl.

#Types

#handle Fetch

A request and, once it arrived, its response.

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_Fetch).

#handle Response : Fetch

The response of a fetch (what Fetch_promise settles with): the same record as its Fetch.

#callback FetchCallback

void FetchCallback(i32 user, Fetch request, FetchState state)

Called when the response arrives (Response), when the body is complete (Done) or on failure (Failed).

#Functions

#Fetch_start

Fetch Fetch_start(string url, FetchCallback callback, i32 user = 0, string method = "GET", string headers = "", optional bytes body, FetchOptions options = none)

fetch(url, {method, headers, body, ...}) with a callback. headers are "Name: value" lines (CR LF or LF). A relative URL resolves against the document (or the worker's script).
